player_prompt.intro:
Oyo ezali Mokili {player_id} akelaka mibano ya Pig Dice.

Mikano:
- Na turne ya yo, oza kosalela '[roll]' or '[hold]'
- Koma 2-6: Konga na turne ya yo
- Koma 1: Koma turne ya yo na komisa turne
- Sala: Konga na turne ya yo na komisa turne
- Yo ya koma {winning_score} pointi azali na mibano

Na turne ya yo, oza kuzwa aloni ya pointi na turne ya yo.
Kotinda na '[roll]' kosala die or '[hold]' kosala pointi ya yo.

board.current_total_scores:
Aloni ya Pointi Ezali: {scores}
Pointi ya mikolo ya yo ezali {turn_total}.
board.first_roll: {observation} Oyo ezali mbala na yo ya liboso.

outcome.winner_by_turn_limit: Mokili {winner_id} alandi na pointi eza na limite ya turne ({scores})
outcome.winner_by_score: Mokili {winner_id} alandi na komona pointi ya {winning_score}!
outcome.draw: Na nsuka ya molɔngɔ, bato nyonso bazali na motángo moko: {scores}
